title: Several live boards (POST /api/tournaments/:slug/live body, batch form)
description: No current sender (Alnasl sends one board per request; mix openresults.live_sim may batch). Same route and headers as live-board.request.schema.json. A body with a `boards` key is a batch: at most 64 items, else 422 invalid_request for the whole request. Each item is judged on its own and answered in order (live-board-batch.response.schema.json).
